_readme: Public edition overrides (itch, GitHub Pages, advertised builds). Loaded on top of cast.json unless the build has the 'family' feature tag. See docs/legal/RISK_AUDIT.md for why each one exists.
_game_title_note: Deliberate (Duff, Nov 26 2026): the title is a generic pun. It never names or shows the real restaurant; the public restaurant stays The Busted Spatula.
